title: `objectui init` writes an `src/index.css` with no `@import "@object-ui/components/style.css"`, so the scaffolded app gets none of the library's styles — the one import quick-start and #3884's measurement both call load-bearing
body:
Out-of-scope finding, measured while implementing #3892. Filed separately: #3892's face is the scaffold's version ranges plus deleting its dead `tailwind.config.js`, and this is a missing line in a different generated file.

## Facts (verified on `origin/main` = `11c1e71e8`)

`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:545` generates the scaffold's entire stylesheet:

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
```

That is the whole file. It never imports the component library's published stylesheet.

The library publishes one, and it is a real export: `packages/components/package.json` declares `"./style.css": "./dist/index.css"`, with `dist` in `files`. A local build of the package emits `dist/index.css` at 161.98 kB.

`content/docs/guide/quick-start.md:55-60` — the page an external consumer follows — teaches exactly that import:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@object-ui/components/style.css";
@import "@object-ui/fields/style.css";
```

So the CLI's own scaffold does not do what this project's documentation tells hand-rolled consumers to do.

## Why the prebuilt import is the load-bearing one

#3884 measured this directly, against a real install (Tailwind 4.3.3 + `@tailwindcss/postcss`), and its readings are what make this finding precise rather than speculative:

- The theme utilities (`bg-primary`, `bg-background`, `border-input`, `ring-ring`) exist **only where the `@theme` block that declares their tokens is compiled**. That block lives in `packages/components/src/index.css`, which `files` does not publish. A consumer therefore cannot obtain them by scanning; the prebuilt `style.css` is the only source.
- Scanning `node_modules` is not a substitute in the other direction either: #3884 measured the full class surface reachable by a `node_modules` glob at 1331 rules, **all** already inside the published `dist/index.css`'s 1410 — the prebuilt CSS is a strict superset of what scanning yields.

I want to be explicit that this finding is **not** "the scaffold is missing `@source` lines". That was my first hypothesis and #3884 falsifies it: those lines are redundant, cost ~100 kB, and buy 14 selectors none of which are needed. The missing thing is the `@import`.

## Impact

A scaffolded project renders ObjectUI components with no ObjectUI styling — the theme utilities its templates lean on (`bg-muted/10`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-background`, `shadow-sm` on `card`) have no tokens behind them. Combined with #4061 (empty component registry), `objectui init` + `npm run dev` does not currently produce the app its README promises. Severity left to triage.

## Not prejudging the fix

Two cells I deliberately did not decide:

1. **Which stylesheets.** quick-start names `@object-ui/components/style.css` and `@object-ui/fields/style.css`; the scaffold's manifest declares neither `@object-ui/fields` nor anything that imports it, so copying both lines would declare-vs-import in the wrong direction (#3755). Probably components only, matching what the scaffold depends on.
2. **Whether the scaffold should follow quick-start's Vite plugin shape at all.** quick-start uses `@tailwindcss/vite`; the scaffold uses `@tailwindcss/postcss` + `autoprefixer` in `postcss.config.js`. Both are valid Tailwind 4 setups and this finding does not depend on the choice — but the divergence is worth a maintainer's eye, since the two pages are read as one story by a new user.

Measurement I could not do offline: compiling a scaffolded project against real published packages to count what the missing import costs in rules. #3884's fixture is the shape that measurement would take.

## Dedup

Searched open issues: `init scaffold plugin register components` (0 hits), `in:title init OR scaffold OR unstyled OR "@source"` (#3907, #3892, #3884). #3884 is the *docs* face (quick-start teaches two redundant `@source` lines) and explicitly scopes to `content/docs/guide/quick-start.md`; #3883 is theming/troubleshooting docs; neither covers the CLI scaffold's generated CSS. #3852 migrated the temp-app generator's pipeline, not `commands/init.ts`.

Related: #3892, #4061. Evidence source: #3884.
